biotools.summary: SUPPA is a tool for analyzing m5C and m6A modifications in RNA sequencing data, particularly for characterizing post-transcriptional modifications in response to Campylobacter jejuni inoculation in chickens. It identifies and analyzes transcripts with modifications, providing insights into immune system regulation and expression regulation.
